acceptanceCriteria.text: A versioned schema explicitly separates forkable prefix and execution attachment.
Canonical serialization/order is deterministic and stable under incidental collection ordering.
Equivalent prefix inputs produce identical `prefix_id` values.
Two different execution attachments can share one `prefix_id` while producing distinct `execution_state_id` values.
Changing repository/base/task/selected-artifact prefix content changes `prefix_id`; changing only session/worktree identity does not.
Volatile fields excluded from identity are explicitly documented/tested.
C0 already-supplied provenance and C1 immutable repository/base facts are represented without eager content duplication.
Property/unit tests cover ordering, hashing, single-field invalidation, prefix-vs-attachment identity, and schema-version behavior.

issue.title: feat: define deterministic Canon prefix and execution-attachment identities
